system.description:
This trait is only available to biomorphs. This morph is adapted for low-gravity environments (0.15 or less) and struggles in higher gravity. 

You suffer the effects of high gravity for every 0.2 g over 0.15. On Mars or Mercury (0.38 g), you would suffer the effects of 1 wound; on Venus or Earth (1 g), you suffer the effects of 3 wounds.
